prior_analysis_correction.correct_finding: All terms are summed into tau_common before wheel application. Actual applied wheel torque at peak is ~0.37 Nm, not 10 Nm. The logged sagittal_term_pitch is a diagnostic value only.
prior_analysis_correction.key_insight: tau_cp = -kp_cp * sagittal_position_error = -30.0 * 0.254 = -7.63 Nm nearly cancels tau_pitch = +10.3 Nm, leaving only +0.28 Nm net tau_common.

event_localization.note: Drift peak (step 1666) occurs BEFORE pitch peak (step 1672). The pitch buildup is gradual over ~1700 steps, not a sudden spike.

acceleration_event.description: Pitch rises from 6 deg to 10 deg in 100 steps (1400-1500)

term_decomposition.saturation_status: sagittal_saturated=False throughout; tau_total_raw=tau_total_clipped=tau_total_smooth; no rate limiting active

upstream_cause_analysis.description: tau_cp (kp_cp=30.0) uses sagittal_position_error as a proxy for capture point error. Combined with tau_position (k_position=10.0), the total position-return coefficient is effectively -40.0 * sag_pos_err. This nearly cancels tau_pitch (kp_pitch=50.0) at large displacements.
upstream_cause_analysis.cancellation_at_large_displacement: At sag_pos_err=0.254m: tau_cp+tau_pos = -10.17 Nm vs tau_pitch = +10.30 Nm

ruled_out.F_initialization_periodic: Control mode transitions at steps 1477/1739/1901/2009 are consequences of pitch, not causes

upstream_cause_analysis.telemetry_artifact_note: sagittal_controller_input_* columns are all zero throughout all 5000 steps. This is a telemetry artifact — variables initialized to 0.0 and only set inside a conditional branch not reached in this run. Controller itself receives correct inputs (confirmed by matching actual wheel torques to computed values).

repeatability.note: Second run crashed with pre-existing UnboundLocalError: local variable 'sagittal_diag' referenced before assignment. Simulator is deterministic (no randomness). All runs produce identical results.

fix_recommendations.name: Disable tau_cp (Recommended)
fix_recommendations.rationale: tau_cp uses sagittal_position_error as a cp proxy, redundant with tau_position. Removing it eliminates the near-cancellation.
fix_recommendations.expected_effect: At step 1666, tau_common increases from +0.28 Nm to +7.91 Nm — 28x increase in corrective torque
fix_recommendations.regression_risk: Low — tau_cp is redundant with tau_position
fix_recommendations.test_required: 5000-step nominal run + height variant regression (high_5cm, low_5cm)

fix_recommendations.name: Reduce kp_cp
fix_recommendations.rationale: Reduces near-cancellation without fully removing cp term

fix_recommendations.name: Increase kp_pitch
fix_recommendations.regression_risk: High — may cause pitch oscillations at steady state

practical_target_achievability.reasoning: Steady state (last 20%) is already within +/-0.033 m. Transient overshoot is caused by insufficient net wheel torque. With kp_cp=0.0, net corrective torque at peak would be ~7.9 Nm instead of ~0.37 Nm — sufficient to prevent pitch buildup from reaching 11.8 deg.
